chose: A word is mumbled when whisper's probability for it is under 0.5, and the mumbled share is over the words that carry a probability; a word without one is neither mumbled nor counted in the share.
options: (a) p under 0.5, words without p left out of the share
(b) p under 0.5, words without p counted as heard
gray: No check or earlier decision says how unsure the transcriber must be before a word reads as mumbled; the value sets the mumbling count the owner sees charted each week.
undo: Change MUMBLE_P in packages/ui/interview-week/src/lib/faults/thresholds.ts, or count words without p in measureAnswer's share.
